purpose: Teach: 一色/小池/岩田/坂口/大山/山内/浜田/平井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、一色氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you and Isshiki-san started that joint venture together.
lines.style: Warm, reminiscent. Soft opening on the reflection. Unhurried pace, the voice of someone who has carried this memory for decades. A gentle question wrapped in a statement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは小池氏を初代主任として任命された
lines.en: Yes. And Father appointed Koike-san as the first manager.
lines.style: Clear, straightforward. A measured nod in the voice. Respectful tone toward the memory. Even cadence—not dwelling, but honoring. Gaze held steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、岩田氏と工場運営を整えられた
lines.en: And when you were young, you worked with Iwata-san to build the factory operations.
lines.style: Softly wistful, the voice of an elder tracing the threads of legacy. Slightly slower pace. Eyes distant. Each phrase carried with weight and care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは坂口氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father made Sakaguchi-san the cornerstone of our public relations.
lines.style: Meditative, almost ritualistic. Speaking as if placing each person carefully into their rightful place. Quiet certainty. A pause before the name, as if seeing the person's face.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、大山氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And you planned the overseas expansion with Oyama-san during those early years.
lines.style: Gentle, deliberate. The voice reaching back to a specific time and place. Slightly trailing off, as if checking whether he's remembering correctly. Wistful but grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは山内氏に経理全般を任された
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted Yamauchi-san with all the accounting.
lines.style: Calm, assured. Speaking as if confirming the rightness of those choices even now. Even tone, no doubt. The voice of someone seeing clearly into the past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、浜田氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And you established the overseas corporation with Hamada-san in those days.
lines.style: Tender and deliberate. The voice of an elder collecting the pieces of a life's work. Slow, reverent pace. A pause between each thought, as if each choice was precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは平井氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father placed all the legal matters in Hirai-san's hands.
lines.style: Quiet, final. The voice settling into completion. Steady and unshakeable. A gentle closure, honoring both the choices and the people who made them possible. Almost a benediction.
